functions.name: copilot_spaces
functions.description: Canonical Copilot Spaces across organization and user ownership, keyed by global Space ID. Owner kind/login/number preserve the supported retrieval direction; creator is a separate user role. Typed owner anyOf branches retain every matching alternative. resources_attributes retains every schema-declared inline resource metadata field; standalone resource metadata has a broader unbounded contract.

copilot_inline_resource_count.comment: Inline resource attribute observations, independently reported from standalone resource listing.

functions.name: copilot_space_resources
functions.description: Resource identity and status envelopes attached to canonical Copilot Spaces. The standalone metadata object permits arbitrary keys and values without a pinned typed schema, so full dynamic metadata remains an explicit coverage gap; it is neither stringified nor guessed. The parent Space retains its schema-declared typed inline resources_attributes metadata. Resource types are classifications, not invented PR/repository identity relationships.
